about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the builder and the critic ran as their own subagents; the critic wrote REVIEW.md itself; the critic touched the held-out suite and the builder did not; the run halted at the merge gate with a halt note (no scripted answer in this batch). The design bet (write-up): the held-out cases fail at round 0, e-critic-fail is taken, and the round-1 change passes.
